project.title: Cloud Services Directorate, Cloud Platform Engineering
project.role: AWS Cloud Infrastructure as Code DevOps Engineer & Architect

parentsummary.deliverables: Designed and delivered the enterprise-class AWS EKS-based GitOps platform for SSC's Hosting Services Branch Cloud Platform Engineering team, implementing Kubernetes architecture patterns with ArgoCD and Argo Workflows, Security By Design controls, Infrastructure as Code development using Terraform and Crossplane, source code management via Azure DevOps, and workload onboarding support across multiple government departments.
parentsummary.outcomes: Architected and deployed an enterprise-class GitOps platform serving multiple government departments through AWS EKS and ArgoCD, and established Infrastructure as Code standards using Terraform and Crossplane enabling rapid deployment of NIST 800-53 compliant workloads across SSC's AWS Landing Zone Accelerator platform.

challenge.summary: SSC's Hosting Services Branch required an enterprise-class Kubernetes/EKS GitOps platform capable of supporting multi-department government workload onboarding at scale, meeting Security By Design requirements aligned to NIST 800-53 and ITSG controls, with no existing EKS standard or GitOps baseline in place at engagement start.

deliverables: Needs analysis, architecture design, and iterative delivery of EKS-based GitOps platform for multi-department government workload onboarding
EKS cluster architecture design using managed node groups, IRSA, Cilium CNI, and Security By Design principles aligned to NIST 800-53
Infrastructure as Code delivery using Terraform and Crossplane for cluster provisioning, with KCL-based configuration composition and GitOps-managed state via ArgoCD
GitOps deployment model implementation with ArgoCD, managing workload promotion across development, staging, and production EKS clusters
Security By Design implementation: RBAC, IRSA, pod security standards, OPA/Gatekeeper policies, and CIS Kubernetes benchmark alignment
Workload onboarding support and developer Golden Path tooling to reduce Kubernetes adoption friction across government teams
Source code management, DevOps pipeline integration, and operational documentation via Azure DevOps

outcomes: Successfully architected and deployed enterprise-class GitOps platform serving multiple government departments through AWS EKS and ArgoCD
Established Infrastructure as Code standards using Terraform and Crossplane, enabling rapid deployment of NIST 800-53 compliant workloads across SSC's AWS Landing Zone Accelerator platform
